blocks.text: Module test A2.4 · Use language
Instructions

Week 91 of the calendar, after verification A2-19 → A2-23. Duration: approx. 90 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10– 12 minutes of conversation with the tutor. Work without notes and dictionary; Correct at the end with the solution. Part B script is at the beginning of solutions: let another person read it or paste it into a voice synthesis app without reading it. The text of part A is without vowels, like real emails and real alerts.

rows: Reading: an email with practical information
Language: ⁧إِنَّ⁩ and sisters, stories, travels and offices, notices and emails, news, Egyptian

blocks.text: Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings. If you do not pass the test, dedicate the week 92 to the weakest unit (look where you lost more points in part C) and repeat the tutor test at the beginning of the week 93; the revision of A2-24 It shortens accordingly.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧دورة عن بعد في الخريف⁩ : ⁧الموضوع⁩ · ⁧لوكا⁩ : ⁧إلى⁩ · ⁧القاهرة⁩ – ⁧مركز اللغات⁩ : ⁧من⁩
⁧تحية طيبة وبعد،السيد لوكا المحترم،⁩
⁧يسعدنا أن نخبركم بأن شهادة الحضور جاهزة، وقد أرسلناها إليكم بالبريد إلى عنوانكم في ميلانو. وإذا لم⁩
⁧تصلكم خلال أسبوعين، فالرجاء إخبارنا.⁩
⁧كما نود أن نعلمكم أن المركز سينظم في الخريف دورة عن بعد للطلاب الذين حضروا الدورة الصيفية.⁩
⁧ستبدأ الدورة يوم الاثنين ٥ أكتوبر، وتستمر ثمانية أسابيع، بمعدل درسين في الأسبوع، يوم الاثنين ويوم⁩
⁧الخميس، من السابعة حتى الثامنة والنصف مساءً بتوقيت القاهرة. ستدرّس الدورة الأستاذة منى عبد⁩
⁧قراءة الأخبار، والاستماع إلى النشرات، وكتابة تقارير قصيرة.⁩ :« ⁧العربية في الإعلام⁩ » ⁧الرحمن، وموضوعها⁩
⁧رسوم الدورة ١٢٠ يورو، وتدفع قبل بدء الدورة. علمًا بأن الطلاب الذين يسجلون قبل ٢٠ سبتمبر يحصلون⁩
⁧على خصم بنسبة عشرة بالمئة. عدد الأماكن محدود: خمسة عشر طالبًا فقط.⁩
⁧للتسجيل، يرجى ملء الاستمارة المرفقة وإرسالها إلى هذا العنوان.⁩

Help: ⁧عَنْ بُعْدٍ⁩ • • remotely • ⁧بِمُعَدَّلِ⁩ • by reason of its value · ⁧بِتَوْقِيتِ القَاهِرَةِ⁩ Cairo Time ⁧الإِعْلَام⁩ • i media • ⁧تَقَارِير⁩ Reports, services. ⁧عِلْمًا بِأَنَّ⁩ The following paragraph is added: ⁧مَلْء⁩ • fill in the form • ⁧سِكْرِتَارِيَّة⁩ Secretariat. Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. What does the center of the attendance certificate say? What does Luke have to do if he doesn't receive it?
2. To whom is the autumn course addressed? When does it start, how long, in what days and at what time (Cairo time)?
3. Who teaches, what is the theme of the course and what activities does it include?
4. How much is it and when is it paid? Who's entitled to a discount, and how much? How many seats are there?
5. How do you sign up? Find in the email two formal opening formulas and closing formula.
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the news twice, with 30 Second pause. Answer in English; 2 points per answer. Useful words: ⁧حَرِيق⁩ Fire. ⁧تَشْجِيع⁩ • promotion ⁧غَزِيرَة⁩ Plenty.
1. Who has gathered, where, and on what have they agreed? When will the program start?
2. What happened downtown? Are there any injuries? What was the cause?
3. What's the news?
4. What's the weather tomorrow, and where? What temperature?
C · Language (12 points)
One point for an answer. Write with your vowels.

blocks.text: D · Written production (8 points)

Write a formal email of about 120 words, vocalized, at the secretariat of the center of part A, to enroll in the distance course. Introduce yourself briefly, tell why you are interested in the course, ask at least two practical questions and indicate what you attach. Mandatory items: object, ⁧السَّيِّدُ⁩ / ⁧السَّيِّدَةُ⁩ … ⁧المُحْتَرَمُ⁩ / ⁧المُحْتَرَمَةُ⁩ (or formal equivalent opening), ⁧تَحِيَّةً طَيِّبَةً وَبَعْدُ⁩ , ⁧أَكْتُبُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِخُصُوصِ⁩ , a phrase with ⁧أَنَّ⁩ or ⁧لِأَنَّ⁩ , two questions, a date or a number, ⁧مُرْفَقٌ⁩ , a formal closure, signature. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4 (heading 6.3). Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1). An email with Egyptian words loses 1 Record point.
E · Oral production: guided conversation (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10–12 minutes.
1. At the door or at the doctor's. Role-playing game chosen by the tutor: renew a document (what it takes,
how much it costs, when it's ready) or describe two disorders and figure out how to take a drug.
2. Tell me something. The tutor reads short news in fuṣḥā (or repeat a report of part B): report it
with ⁧قَالَ إِنَّ⁩ , ⁧أَعْلَنَ أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧وَفْقًا لِـ⁩ .
3. A trip. Tell in two minutes a real or imaginary trip: background with ⁧كَانَ⁩ + imperfect, events at
Perfect, at least four connective ( ⁧ثُمَّ⁩ , ⁧بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ⁩ , ⁧فَجْأَةً⁩ , ⁧فِي النِّهَايَةِ⁩ …).
4. Recognize. The tutor says five short sentences: for each one say if he is Egyptian or fuṣḥā and if he is Egyptian, repeat it in
fuṣḥā. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. The Pronunciation evaluates the tutor; Without tutoring the E part remains unfinished. The task 4 It's part of the Accuracy.
